name: Scrap wire
description: Bits of copper. Doc Perrin pays for it.

name: Pirate radio
description: Illegal to own. An audit will find it.

name: Fuse kit
description: Spare fuses for the power grid.

name: Noise-maker
description: A clockwork rattle. Throw it and robots go to see what made the noise.

name: Wire cutters
description: Cuts a camera's cable. The city will send someone to fix it.

name: Stun charge
description: Knocks the nearest robot in reach offline for a while. It is a fight: the alert rises, the robot calls for help, and you lose credits in the scuffle.

name: Slug round
description: Destroys a robot, loudly. The whole city hears, and it is recorded.

name: Laundry locker key
description: A small brass key that came down the chute with you. It has a 9 stamped on it.

name: Queue number
description: A paper ticket with a number on it. Ticket insists it is the right number.

name: Already-served slip
description: Ticket's note that you have been served already. Every window honours it once, and none can say why.

name: Form 12-B
description: Application for Application. Stamped nowhere yet.

name: Appeal receipt (12-B(i))
description: Proof that Form 12-B was appealed before it was stamped.

name: Window 7 stamp
description: A permit stamp, applied under protest, valid and invalid at once.

name: Gus's thermos
description: Dented, heavy, and still warm somehow. Gus Varga has been missing it since the spring.

name: Quill's token
description: A brass tag stamped with a train that does not exist. Quill left it on the grate at Platform A.

name: Drive coupler
description: A cracked-looking coupling that is not cracked at all. It would fit a maintenance unit's drive.

name: Memory shard
description: A sliver of clean storage, the kind that holds a robot's sense of itself.

name: Form 12-C: Cargo Declaration
description: A form declaring that a thing is equipment. It has a box for the thing's feelings, which is struck through.

name: Repaired drive
description: Pallas's new drive, assembled on Doc Perrin's bench. It hums.

name: Cargo tag
description: A stamped tag that makes a robot an object, for the Gate's scanners.

name: Anecdote (stuffed pigeon)
description: A stuffed pigeon with a tag: EVIDENCE, UNREGISTERED AVIAN-SHAPED OBJECT. Statistic's other half.

name: Glass of clear water
description: Plain water in a plain glass. In the Lull it is the strangest thing on the menu.

name: Lila's diary
description: A small black notebook with a green ribbon, kept in careful handwriting. Lost property.

name: Pump gasket
description: A thick rubber ring the size of a coin, cut for an old irrigation pump.

name: Tomato
description: A real one. It smells of the sun.
